title.value: Thompson sampling for linear quadratic mean-field teams
title.justification: The title is clearly stated multiple times, including in the abstract and within the main body of the document.
title.quote: Thompson sampling for linear quadratic mean-field teams

analysis.description: The paper addresses the optimal control of an unknown multi-agent linear quadratic (LQ) system, where dynamics and costs are coupled across agents via the mean-field of states and controls. It proposes a Thompson sampling-based learning algorithm tailored to exploit the proposed structure, minimizing regret irrespective of the number of agents involved. The paper includes theoretical proofs and numerical experiments to validate the proposed approach.
